node_definition.done_when: A new tests/test_a_plan_review_reads_the_change.py shows: a review composed after editing one section of a reviewed plan carries that section's diff and full text, the previous findings and their answers, and no other section's text; the stored review record names the plan commit it read; a dispatch of an unedited section succeeds while another section is uncovered; a dispatch of the edited section is refused until a review covers it. require_plan_reviewed in reckon/crew/routing.py takes the dispatched section and requires only it and the document unit to be covered; §11's admission check (already landed or landing first, which is why this node runs after it) uses the same per-unit predicate. The test files importing each edited module add no failures against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths. The coordinator runs the full importer arms.
node_definition.goal: Compose a plan review from the plan's git diff since the reviewed commit, and gate a section's dispatch on its own coverage only
node_definition.negative_control: restore the plan-wide gate; the unedited-section arm must fail
